Plot multi-crop CV contours and experimental-unit criteria

Source: R/multicrop_curvature_plot.R
plot_multicrop_curvature.Rd

Creates faceted CV contours and the two sectional-curvature loci. Marks the Gaussian, simultaneous sectional, and marginal-efficiency solutions. The dashed guides and numerical labels refer only to the sectional solution.

Usage

plot_multicrop_curvature(
  trials = NULL,
  min_plots = 2L,
  unit_width_m = 1, unit_length_m = 1,
  cv_interval = 5, grid_size = 180L, target_slope = 1
)

Arguments

trials

Named list of trial matrices. NULL uses the four example crops.

min_plots

Minimum number of experimental units per configuration.

unit_width_m, unit_length_m

Physical dimensions of one basic unit, in metres.

cv_interval

CV contour interval in percentage points.

grid_size

Number of grid points per axis.

target_slope

Positive target CV decrease (percentage points per basic unit) for the marginal-efficiency criterion.

Value

A faceted ggplot object.

Examples

plot_multicrop_curvature()
